headline: Playing for 2027 holds off mikelanta 113.74-110.50 as Kirkumcised Penix edges Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier in a 3.26-point thriller
meme_brief: Two games this week came down to a field goal's worth of points while a third team got run off the field by 64 — the guy with a losing record and the quietly brutal name 'Playing for 2027' somehow wins by a field goal, and the league's best team, run by a co-commissioner, loses a game it probably should've had in the bag.
recap:
The week's headline game was a dead heat: Playing for 2027 beat mikelanta 113.74 to 110.50, a margin of exactly 3.24 points, the closest finish of the week. Jonah Coleman, Tee Higgins and Luther Burden III did the heavy lifting for the winners, while mikelanta got 27.34 from Bryce Young and 20.76 from Caleb Williams but couldn't close the gap. Barely less dramatic was the top-of-the-standings scrap between Kirkumcised Penix and Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier, decided by 3.26 points — Kirkumcised Penix's Bijan Robinson (23.7) and Darren Waller (23.0) were enough to outlast Kenneth Walker III's 34.3-point day on the other side, handing the league's only two-loss team its second defeat.

The blowout belonged to NateDawg726, who beat Theme From The Bottom 111.34 to 46.9, a 64.44-point gap built on CeeDee Lamb's 28.5 and Dak Prescott's 23.5 against a Theme From The Bottom lineup that started Fernando Mendoza and Kyle Williams for a combined zero points. Elsewhere, demon44 ran up 136.54 behind Brock Purdy's 30.28 and Drake Maye's 27.26 to beat Full Chuba by 37.18, The Josh Allens beat Brent Looking 4 His Keys by 20.94 behind Puka Nacua's 28-point outing, and LaHorrible beat Silverbacks (100 vs 1) by 19.28 thanks to C.J. Stroud's 46.36, the single highest individual score in the league this week.

The week's costliest bench call belonged to Brent Looking 4 His Keys, who sat Justin Herbert's 13.42 points in favor of a scoreless night from Lamar Jackson, a 13.42-point gift to The Josh Allens — and now the third straight week this exact pattern has shown up on that roster. NateDawg726 also kept its own streak alive, benching Blake Corum's 11.8 for a zero from Ladd McConkey, the third consecutive week with a real, costly bench mistake there too. Full Chuba's loss came with its own gut punch: Tank Dell scored 18.5 on the bench while Mike Gesicki started and managed 3.1, a 15.4-point swing in a game decided by 37.

The Josh Allens, Playing for 2027, Kirkumcised Penix, demon44, LaHorrible and mikelanta all avoided a bench mistake entirely this week, while Silverbacks (100 vs 1) got Jordan Love's 42.18 and still lost to LaHorrible.
transaction_desk: Nobody paid real cost for anything this week. Silverbacks (100 vs 1) was the only team to actually burn a waiver claim, spending its number 7 priority slot (middle of the pack) on Devin Singletary, who returned 4.9 points in his debut — a shrug of a result for a shrug of a price. Everything else moved through free agency uncontested. Brent Looking 4 His Keys added Joe Fagnano, a plausible insurance piece behind Jacoby Brissett, for nothing, and got 1.7 points back for the trouble. Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier ran through three moves in order — Drew Lock in for Tyler Huntley, Reggie Virgil in for Roschon Johnson, then Audric Estime added outright — all free, with Lock immediately returning 14.6 points and Estime chipping in 14.2, a tidy bit of depth-churn for a team that's already 7-2. Theme From The Bottom added Stetson Bennett IV for nothing and got nothing, continuing its habit of volume at the position without results. Playing for 2027 swapped Gregory Desrosiers in for Zonovan Knight, also free, for a modest 2.0-point return. None of this week's moves cost anyone anything real, and none of them moved the needle much either.

power_rankings.blurb: Still 7-2 and the clear points leader in the league even after a three-point loss and a bench mistake with Michael Penix Jr. sitting for the second straight week.
Jordan Love dropped 42.18 and it still wasn't enough — the loss to LaHorrible stings more than the record shows.
A 64-point demolition of the league's worst team, but a third straight week of a real bench mistake is a pattern worth watching.
C.J. Stroud's 46.36 was the best individual score in the league this week and it carried the whole operation.
Puka Nacua's 28 points powered a comfortable win with no bench mistakes to speak of.
Joe Burrow's 35.54 wasn't enough to survive demon44, and Tank Dell rotting on the bench for 18.5 points didn't help.
Brock Purdy and Drake Maye combined for a blowout win, bench mistake and all.
Won the week's tightest game against the league leader behind Bijan Robinson and a two-TE flex of Travis Kelce and Darren Waller.
Won by 3.24 with Shedeur Sanders scoring 26.68 points from the bench — imagine if that had been in the lineup.
Three straight weeks now of a costly bench mistake involving Lamar Jackson, and the record shows it.
Lost by the length of a field goal despite 27.34 from Bryce Young and 20.76 from Caleb Williams.
Lost by 64 points, started a scoreless Fernando Mendoza and Kyle Williams, and added a fourth-straight week of free agents that haven't moved the needle.

standings_narrative:
The top five seeds by record are settled for now: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier at 7-2 holds the one seed, with Silverbacks (100 vs 1), NateDawg726 and LaHorrible all at 6-3 rounding out seeds two through four, and The Josh Allens at 5-4 taking the fifth seed. The sixth and final playoff spot doesn't go to the next-best record — it goes to whichever remaining team has scored the most points overall, and that's Full Chuba, sitting at 4-5 but with 1175.48 points, enough to hold a 106.2-point cushion over the next closest team in that group.

That next closest team is demon44, also 4-5 but trailing Full Chuba in total points and sitting on the bubble. Brent Looking 4 His Keys, Kirkumcised Penix and Playing for 2027 are all also 4-5 but further back in points, and Theme From The Bottom at 1-8 is effectively out of the picture entirely.
look_ahead: Next week, Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier (7-2) faces The Josh Allens (5-4) in a matchup between two teams both comfortably inside the current playoff picture. Silverbacks (100 vs 1) at 6-3 draws Theme From The Bottom at 1-8, a lopsided record matchup on paper. LaHorrible (6-3) and Playing for 2027 (4-5) meet. NateDawg726 (6-3) and Kirkumcised Penix (4-5) face off. demon44 (4-5) and mikelanta (3-6) meet with demon44 on the bubble for the points-based sixth seed, and Brent Looking 4 His Keys (4-5) takes on Full Chuba (4-5), a direct meeting between two teams separated in the standings only by total points.

running_jokes: Brent Looking 4 His Keys has now made a real, costly bench mistake in three straight weeks, every time involving Lamar Jackson in the lineup over a better option.
NateDawg726 has also posted a costly bench mistake in three straight weeks now, this time benching Blake Corum's 11.8 for a scoreless Ladd McConkey.
Theme From The Bottom keeps adding free agents in bulk (a fourth straight week) while sitting at the bottom of the league, with little to show for it yet.
Full Chuba has a bench mistake in back-to-back weeks now, this time losing 15.4 points by sitting Tank Dell for Mike Gesicki.
